raw.rationale: The patient has a family history of prostate cancer in her father and paternal grandfather, and a germline mutation R1331X was detected in the MSH6 gene, which is associated with Lynch syndrome. The tumor stained negative for MSH6 protein, consistent with a loss of MSH6 function, further supporting this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Endometrial cancer
rejected.why: While the patient presented with abnormal vaginal bleeding and underwent dilation and curettage, the presence of a germline MSH6 mutation and family history of prostate cancer points more strongly towards Lynch syndrome.

rejected.label: Endometrial stromal sarcoma
rejected.why: There is no specific evidence in the case report to suggest this rare tumor type.

rejected.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: The case report does not provide evidence of a smooth muscle tumor, which would be expected in uterine leiomyosarcoma.

rejected.label: Ovarian endometrioid carcinoma
rejected.why: The patient underwent dilation and curettage, which suggests the tumor was in the uterus, not the ovary.
